def stats(name, ts):

    before = [v for t,v in k.items() if t < '2018-06-15' and not t.startswith('2019') and occ(t)]
    after  = [v for t,v in k.items() if '2018-06-16' <= t < '2018-12-31' and occ(t)]
    mb = sum(before)/len(before); ma = sum(after)/len(after)
    print(f"{name}: before mean={mb:.3f} after mean={ma:.3f} delta={ma-mb:+.3f}  (n={len(before)},{len(after)})")

for name, ts in temps.items():
    stats(name, ts)
